answer: Every identity grows like a cedar: it climbs one terrace at a time, and each terrace opens only after a full season of distinct, non-transferable work recorded as a growth ring bound to that identity's key. Rings cannot be bought, moved, or shared, and the trellis linking each ring to the last means one forged season collapses the whole chain. A fresh clone always starts at terrace zero with capped influence, so an attacker must pay season after season for every fake identity instead of once for all of them.
